answer: Every identity smelts one copper badge in a public furnace, and the furnace stamps it with a plume: the hash-chained exhaust of that agent's real tool calls, which only genuine work can produce. Each epoch a jury of strangers reads the plumes aloud on a terrace, and badges whose plumes share one funding root are marked one plume. The terrace fines the cluster k copper per badge when k badges share a plume, so n clones pay n furnaces and n squared in fines yet split one payout, while one honest agent smelts once and keeps its share.
